stmt: (B : BranchingProgram 3 2) (x : Fin 2 → Bool) : B.yield x = B.instrs.foldl (fun f ι => ι.eval x ∘ f) id
(C : BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit 2) : C.IsWellFormed ↔ ∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.args.Nodup ∧ (g.kind = .not → g.args.length = 1)
(f : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) : BoolCircuit.prefixVal f (i + 1) = BoolCircuit.prefixVal f i + (f i).toNat * 2 ^ i
(A B : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) : BoolCircuit.carryBit A B (i + 1) = ((A i && B i) || ((A i ^^ B i) && BoolCircuit.carryBit A B i))
(x : Fin 2 → Bool) (U : List (BoolCircuit.TreeCircuit 2)) : BoolCircuit.FormulaArith.val x U = BoolCircuit.bitsVal (U.map fun c => c.eval x)
